# Ordinance No. 09, Series of 2008

**Pitogo Municipal Investment and Incentives Code of 2008**

## Summary

This ordinance enacts the Pitogo Municipal Investment and Incentives Code of 2008. It establishes policies and guidelines for promoting and encouraging domestic and foreign investments in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. The code defines investment policies, creates the Pitogo Municipal Investment and Incentives Board (PMIIB), and outlines incentives for registered enterprises.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Title and Declaration of Policy:** This ordinance shall be known and cited as the "PITOGO MUNICIPAL INVESTMENT AND INCENTIVES CODE of 2008". It declares the policy of the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon to promote and encourage domestic and foreign investments in the municipality.
2.  **Scope and Coverage:** This Code shall apply to all persons, entities or enterprises, belonging to micro, small, medium and large-scale categories in preferred areas of investments in agribusiness, manufacturing, eco-tourism and services and other areas of investments as may be determined from time to time by the Board.
3.  **Definition of Terms:** Defines key terms used in the code, including "Board," "Center," "Code," "Municipality," "Existing enterprises/Establishments," "Expansion projects," "Incentives," "Local Personnel or Worker," "New Investors/Enterprises," "Preferred/Priority areas of investment," "Registered enterprises," "Capitalization," and "Project Study."
4.  **Creation of the Pitogo Municipal Investment and Incentives Board:** Creates the Pitogo Municipal Investment and Incentives Board (PMIIB) to implement the provisions of the Code.
5.  **Composition of the Board:** The Board shall be composed of the Municipal Mayor (Chairman), Municipal Vice-Mayor (Vice-Chairman), and various representatives from the [[Sangguniang Bayan]], government departments, tourism, agriculture, cooperatives, and the business sector.
6.  **Powers and Functions of the Board:** The primary function of the Board shall be to establish a favorable and consistent policy on business that will encourage and support private sector investments in consonance with the development needs and objectives of the municipality.
7.  **Creation of the Pitogo Municipal Trade and Investment Promotion Center (PMTIC):** The Pitogo Municipal Trade and Investment Center is hereby created and will serve as the Secretariat of the Board.
8.  **Investment Priorities Plan:** Defines the criteria for determining investment priority areas, including long-run comparative advantage, economic soundness, extent of contribution to a specific development goal, market and technical considerations, and value of social objectives.
9.  **Registration of Enterprises:** Outlines the qualifications and requirements for new enterprises intending to avail of incentives as provided for in this Code.
10. **Incentives to Registered Enterprises:** Guarantees to all registered enterprises their full entitlement of the following incentives: full exemption from payments of permits, exemption from business tax, exemption from real property tax, exemption from tax on transfer of real property ownership, exemption from franchise tax, exemption from amusement tax, and exemption from land tax.
11. **Investment Promotion Fund:** Appropriation covering the current operating expenditures and capital outlays for the Board and the Pitogo Municipal Trade and Investment Center shall be included in the annual municipal budget in the General Fund and in the 20% Annual Development Fund.
12. **Sanctions for Non-Submission of Reportorial Requirements:** For late submission of the reportorial requirements, every registered enterprise shall be fined in accordance with the following schedule: 1st violation - Php 5.00 per day every violation, 2nd violation - Php 10.00 per day every violation, 3rd violation and subsequent violations - Php 20.00 per day violation.
